title: JustBed
description: A simple utility to teleport back to your bed respawn point with a single command. Lightweight and perfect for survival servers.
body:
# 🛏️ JustBed
**Get back to sleep instantly!**

JustBed is a minimalist utility for **1.21.x (Mounts of Mayhem)** that allows players to return to their set bed location without having to use the respawn screen.

### 🚀 Features
- **Instant Teleport:** Use `/bed` to return to your last slept-in bed.
- **Smart Checks:** The plugin detects if you actually have a valid bed location.
- **Audio Feedback:** Unique sounds for successful teleports and errors.

### 🛠 Commands
- **/bed** - Teleports you to your bed. (Available to everyone by default)

---

**JustBed** – *No more walking home. Just sleep.*
